coverage.method: Sitemap/navigation discovery, page-family HTML/CSS inspection, selected browser screenshots and runtime probes where permitted.
coverage.viewports: 1440px desktop and 390px mobile; not every source page was rendered.
coverage.limits: Public page families sampled, not every article, locale, private app or interaction state. Source-only theme/motion declarations are not runtime verification.

color.palette_type: warm greige monochrome driven by ONE ink color per theme — nearly every text/border/surface tone is the fg at a color-mix(oklab) opacity step; single burnt-orange accent

light.text_ladder: text 100% / mid 50% / secondary 60% / tertiary 40% of fg

dark.note: dark theme keeps the same opacity-ladder architecture; html:has([data-origin-dark]) also flips theme

color.accent: #f54e00 burnt orange (--color-theme-accent) — the only saturated brand color; warning states borrow it
color.product_colors: ansi-green #1f8a65 / ansi-red #cf2d56 for terminal + diff UI (inserted/removed line backgrounds at 8/6% alpha)
color.agent_timeline: muted pastel coding for agent activity: thinking #dfa88f (salmon), grep #9fc9a2 (green), read #9fbbe0 (blue), edit #c0a8dd (purple)
color.insights_charts: a 10-hue chart family (orange/brown/salmon/amber/green/sky/blue/lavender/pink/red) each with secondary+tertiary dark variants — data-viz gets its own warm-tuned palette
color.contrast_strategy: soft warm ink-on-paper; hierarchy via the opacity ladder rather than distinct grays; color appears only as the orange accent, product ANSI hues, and chart/timeline palettes

typography.fonts: CursorGothic throughout marketing; Berkeley Mono for code/terminal; EB Garamond in editorial and embedded browser content. Font roles must follow their surface.
typography.marketing: Home h1 26/32.5, weight 400, tracking -0.325px; mobile 24.375/30.469. Feature h3 22/28.6, tracking -0.11px. Pricing h1 52/59.8, tracking -1.3px.
typography.scale: Source type ramp: 14,22,26,36,52,72px. Display tracking tightens from -0.005em to -0.03em; hierarchy is mostly size, not boldness.

spacing.base_unit: 4px Tailwind + custom g-grid tokens (--spacing-g0.25 … g3 mapped to xs–2xl); custom breakpoint md at 660px
spacing.content_density: airy marketing sections; dense faithful product recreations inside demo frames

layout.frame: 1440px viewport has a 1300px content rail with ~70px margins; header reserves 52px height.
layout.hero: Modest left-aligned 26px headline and pill actions over a giant desktop/CLI/browser demo; landscape painting is contained within the demo frame.
layout.sections: Wide warm-gray feature panels, alternating text/product views, logos and dated highlights; much larger type reserved for later statements and final CTA.
layout.pricing: 52px centered heading and monthly/yearly pill; four equal warm-tint plan cards, with secondary segmented controls inside individual/team plans.
layout.mobile: At 390px the header reduces to logo, Sign in and hamburger; CTA becomes Get started; oversized product replica is clipped horizontally instead of shrunk to fit.
layout.locales: English and /cn/home use the same design tokens; localized demo text is a content variant.

shape.radius_scale: rounded-sm and rounded-full dominate; buttons are full pills (border-radius 3.40282e38px — max-float pill); cards 10–12px; tiny 2px radii inside product replicas
shape.border_usage: the fg-alpha border ladder (2.5→20%) does all edging; 1px borders throughout

elevation.shadow_style: soft and sparse: card shadows like 0 18px 46px at ~34% black in dark demo frames; marketing surfaces rely on the warm card-step ladder instead of shadows
elevation.depth_cues: 5-step card tonal ladder + alpha borders; glassy gradients only inside phone/demo replicas

iconography.style: geometric line icons + the angular Cursor cube logo; 110 inline SVGs on the homepage

motion.philosophy: product-demo choreography over decorative motion: keyframes are almost all for the embedded demos
motion.keyframes_observed: streaming-word-fade (LLM text streaming), shimmer / shimmer-slide, mobile-chat-enter, mobileRecordingWaveform, mobileWorking* opacity trio, mobile-interaction-glow/pulse, gallery-marquee-item-slide-up, navItemFade/SlideIn/Out, newsletter-submit-pulse, pulse-bit/emit, shake, fade-in
motion.libraries: no Three.js/GSAP detected; CSS keyframes + React

components.buttons: .btn system: primary = ink-filled pill (bg fg color, label in bg color — inverts per theme), secondary = card-03 fill + 1px soft border, ghost = transparent + 20% border, quaternary/quinary text buttons; sizes xs/sm/md-sm; weight 400 always
components.demo_frames: signature component: full theme-token recreations of Cursor Desktop (chrome/editor/product-text tokens), CLI terminal (Berkeley Mono + ansi colors), Mission Control kanban ('进行中/待审查' queues with diff stats '+135 -21'), iPhone frame (mobile-phone-* token set), visual-feedback picker overlay — the marketing site ships a working design-system replica of the product
components.agent_timeline: activity stream with per-action pastel color coding (thinking/grep/read/edit)
components.changelog_cards: dated updates + '近期亮点' highlights grid
components.wallpaper: the in-demo desktop wallpaper is an alpine-lake landscape oil painting (Bierstadt-school) — pastoral art inside the machine
components.localization: full zh-CN translation including UI demo content (任务卡片, 构建落地页) — CJK text set in the same CursorGothic/system stack

design_style.mood: Warm, understated, regular-weight developer tooling with an olive ink and greige paper palette.
design_style.composition: Small opening statement makes the full-scale product demonstration dominant; calm feature panels and editorial spacing follow. One ink color expands into text/border/surface opacity ladders.
design_style.imagery: DOM replicas of desktop, CLI, mobile and browser surfaces; alpine painting wallpaper inside the demo. Product screenshots and media on other routes should not be ruled out.
design_style.interaction: Activity states, terminal output and streaming text communicate agent progress; ink pills and faint warm borders keep surrounding chrome quiet.

visual_effects.technology: Homepage sampled with zero canvas and one logo MP4 element; marketing/product replicas are principally React DOM and CSS.
visual_effects.demo: Theme-aware desktop/CLI/browser surfaces. Source keyframes include streaming-word-fade, shimmer, shimmer-slide, mobile-chat-enter and recording/working indicators.
visual_effects.imagery: Static landscape painting supplies the large demo backdrop; it is not a full-page shader. A logo-light-theme.mp4 was present, autoplay=false and loop=false at inspection.
visual_effects.motion: Gallery and demo sequences are scoped to their components; nav fades and button states are modest. Do not infer runtime absence from missing global library names.
visual_effects.themes: Warm light/dark token ladders retained from current CSS; rendered samples here are light.

page_families./home; /cn/home: Shared warm marketing shell and localized product replicas.
page_families./pricing: Four plan cards, nested tier controls and monthly/yearly switch.
page_families./enterprise; /features: Enterprise/features source uses the same palette with different product-proof panels.
page_families./docs; /download: Technical navigation and platform/distribution routes; do not inherit oversized marketing demo composition.
